What's your warranty policy on defective items?
Our warranty covers defects in materials and workmanship under normal household use. The coverage period depends on the item:
Warmers purchased before March 20, 2026: 1 year from purchase.
Warmers purchased on or after March 20, 2026: 6 months from purchase. Registering within 60 days of purchase makes the warmer eligible for a free 2-year limited warranty.
Warmer lightbulbs: 90 days from purchase.
Silicone dishes: 6 months from purchase.
During the initial warranty period, manufacturer-defective products or parts are replaced at no charge. During the extended limited-warranty period, replacement is offered at a 50% discount.
